auto_events.text: Tron hop TAk1 → Hop TAk1xJ: 120,000,000 TRX ($40.2M)

notes.headline: Binance hot wallets drained. Here is where it is going.
context: Binance Hot Wallet 14 is EIP-7702 delegated to a contract the attacker deployed hours earlier. That is how a single transaction emptied it.

Tether, Circle, Paxos, Ripple, World Liberty, First Digital and Binance (wBETH) have frozen about $2.8B of the attacker's tokens (each checked onchain). The attacker is racing to swap the rest into ETH and TRX, which cannot be frozen.

timeline.text: Signer 0x7C86…5CA0 gets 0.3 ETH in three 0.1 ETH withdrawals from Tornado Cash.
The signer deploys an earlier contract, 0x19bee294 (likely a test run).

The same signer deploys contract 0x63e842b0, about 4 hours before the drain. Binance Hot Wallet 14 is now EIP-7702 delegated to this contract (checked onchain), which is how one transaction could empty it.
Binance's BTC hot wallet sends 18,270 BTC ($1.44B) to bc1q0mtc…2mnm. It is split into 1,000 BTC chunks across about 19 new addresses, and none of it has moved since.
970,537 SOL ($94M) goes from Binance to AffzFD…BEaU on Solana.
First pulls from Binance wallets on Base and Optimism.
Binance's Tron hot wallet sends 612.7M USDT and 46.4M TRX to TG5i…wzsGi.
The big one: one transaction, sent by the Tornado-funded signer, empties Binance Hot Wallet 14 into 0x5227…2f8c. That is 64 tokens, $2.54B.
More Binance hot wallets send $1.06B, including 780M USDC, plus funds on Arbitrum and Avalanche.
500M USDT split to 0x9749 and 200M USDT to 0x0Ddf. Address-poisoning spam starts within minutes.
325M USDT swapped to 122,316 ETH on Uniswap and 1inch.
Tron: 300M USDT to TPBk, 234M swapped to 639M TRX on SUN.io.
Freezes: Tether freezes 971M USDT and Circle 823M USDC in 0x5227; Tether freezes 312.7M + 66M USDT on Tron.
A relay of fresh wallets (0x8d53, 0x77ED, 0x7Aa4) swaps $100M+ more USDT to ETH and sends $161M on to 0xCcBE.
29,934 wBETH and 217.5M ENA ($116M) moved from the main wallet to 0x7f9D…15E3.
Hot Wallet 14 sends another 200.4M USDT to the main wallet. The wallet is still delegated to the attacker's contract, so new funds landing in it get swept. That USDT is frozen on arrival.
The attacker spreads ETH, PEPE, AAVE, UNI and AVAX across 10+ fresh wallets. All of 0x9749's ETH (122,310 ETH, $278M) moves to 0xc887.
$13.2M of WBTC moves from the main wallet to 0xB3dd and is swapped to ETH on Uniswap.
Tron: all 46.4M TRX ($16.4M) moves from TG5i to a new wallet, TRBd…2PRki. The frozen USDT stays behind.
The attacker starts selling altcoins from the main wallet. ZAMA ($5.9M), ZRO ($5.3M) and RSR ($4.7M) each go to a fresh wallet and are sold for ETH on Uniswap.
Arbitrum: 74.6M ARB and 8,426 ETH ($30M) move from 0x3E2b to 0x…0DA0.

First bridge cash-out: 0x554D swaps 200k AVAX for 1.56M USDC on Avalanche and burns it through Circle's CCTP bridge. It is minted at 23:27 to 0xc39e on Ethereum, and Circle has frozen that address (checked onchain).
Tether also froze the main wallet's 8.41M USDt on Avalanche and 6.2M USDT0 on Polygon (checked onchain).
Tron: two parcels of about $600k TRX keep hopping through new wallets every 15–20 min (15+ hops so far), probably testing a cash-out route. The tracker stops following them after hop 8.
17,260 ETH ($38.8M) moves from the main wallet to a new wallet, 0x03b0…20ea, where it sits for now.

Tron wallet TRBd sent out all its TRX (about $16M) in $600k–$1.4M parcels and is now empty. The TRX is split into uneven amounts and shuffled across many new wallets, some of them reused attacker hops. Arkham shows no exchange deposit yet.
The big Tron TRX stash starts moving: TSpe (about $229M of TRX) splits into 5 new wallets of $40–53M each. No exchange deposit yet.
A second sweep from the still-delegated Hot Wallet 14: about 100 smaller tokens (ARKM, STRK, GRT, POL, CHZ…), about $38M in all, go to 0xA97b. Found via Arkham's attacker profile.
Avalanche: 0x8035 sends $13.8M of AVAX to 0xaD45, which sells it for USDC through ParaSwap/Velora. The USDC goes to 0x1192… and moves on right away (not frozen).
That $2.7M of USDC is bridged from Avalanche to Ethereum through Circle's CCTP (not frozen this time), swapped to ETH, and sent to 0x2948…, which has already moved it on.
Tron wallet TRBd is refilled with about 101M TRX ($34M), so the attacker is gathering TRX back into one hub wallet.

More issuer freezes confirmed onchain: XAUt, PAXG, USD1, FDUSD, WLFI and others in the main wallet, wBETH in 0x7f9D (Binance) and RLUSD in 0xE702 (Ripple). Frozen total is now about $2.81B (tip from the community).
